entries.title: UAE economy: On the verge of collapse or on way to recovery?

entries.title: Russia: Prison for opposition leader over war criticism
entries.snippet: Lev Shlosberg of the Yabloko party has been sentenced to over 11 years in a penal colony for criticizing the war in Ukraine. "A single person is imprisoned, yet fear seeps into the hearts of millions," he said in court.

entries.title: Germany: Bundeswehr troop numbers reach 13-year high
entries.snippet: Germany's Defense Ministry is reporting a comparatively rare success story in its bid to bolster troop numbers. At the end of July, the total stood at around 186,700, roughly 3,700 more than a year earlier — a 2% boost.

entries.title: India's testing agency in focus after more exams canceled

entries.title: Fatty food raises risk of colorectal cancer

entries.title: Germany news: Belgium blaze kept out of Germany for now

entries.title: US actress Hayden Panettiere dies at 36

entries.title: Hundreds flee as Belgium battles wildfire at German border

entries.title: India temple stampede in Bihar kills 7
entries.snippet: At least seven people were killed after a stampede broke out at a Hindu shrine in eastern India. An investigation into the incident is underway.
